methodologyNotes: Ten Thunderbolt 4 and Thunderbolt 3 laptop docking stations were researched covering CalDigit, Dell, Kensington, Anker, OWC, Plugable, Belkin, Sonnet, and Razer. Primary sources were manufacturer product pages and official stores; secondary sources included Laptop Mag, XDA Developers, Windows Central, Tech Advisor, AppleInsider, and MacRumors reviews for corroboration. Each priceUsd was re-verified against a live manufacturer/retailer page on 2026-06-15. Power delivery (PD) watts refer to the rated output to the host laptop; total_ports counts all physical connectors including upstream host, audio, SD slots, and all USB/TB ports; ethernet values are stated maximums (GbE = 1 Gbps); max_external_displays reflects the host-connected display capability with a Thunderbolt 4 host. Two source URLs in the original draft were broken or pointed to the wrong product and were replaced (Dell WD22TB4, OWC Thunderbolt 4 Dock). accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: CalDigit TS4
products.provenance: Price $379.99 confirmed directly on the CalDigit US store product page (fetched 2026-06-15). 18 ports (3x TB4 40Gb/s, 3x USB-C 10Gb/s, 5x USB-A, etc.), up to 98W PD, 2.5GbE, and both SD 4.0 + microSD 4.0 (UHS-II) readers all verified on the store page and manufacturer spec page. Dual-display max with a TB4 host (dual 4K/6K). 2022 release confirmed via CalDigit announcement.

products.name: CalDigit TS3 Plus
products.priceNote: Original MSRP; street price may vary, product approaching end of life
products.provenance: Manufacturer spec page and Amazon listing confirm 15 ports, 87W PD, Gigabit Ethernet, UHS-II SD 4.0 (312 MB/s), TB3 host, dual 4K (or single 5K) display support. MSRP $249.99 corroborated by MacRumors review and Amazon; product shipped February 2018 per CalDigit press archive.

products.name: Dell WD22TB4
products.priceNote: Dell listed price / MSRP ($299 from Dell per Laptop Mag); model now largely superseded by WD25TB4
products.provenance: Original draft source URL (dell.com /apd/210-bdqh/docks) now redirects to a 'page cannot be found' warning (the WD22TB4 is discontinued in favor of the WD25TB4 at $299.99), so the source was replaced with the Best Buy product page for the WD22TB4. Price $299 from Dell, 11 ports, 130W PD for Dell systems (90W non-Dell), up to four 4K external displays, Gigabit Ethernet, and NO SD card reader all confirmed by the Laptop Mag review. Released April 2022.

products.name: Kensington SD5700T
products.priceNote: MSRP from kensington.com (now listed Discontinued/Out of Stock)
products.provenance: MSRP $269.99 confirmed directly on Kensington's product page (now marked Discontinued/Out of Stock). 11 ports (4x TB4, 4x USB-A, GbE, audio, UHS-II SD 4.0), 90W PD 3.0, dual 4K (single 8K@30) display support, Gigabit Ethernet (10/100/1000) all verified on the manufacturer page. Available 2021; Laptop Mag review listed $289.99 at the time (retail markup over MSRP).

products.name: Anker 777 Thunderbolt Docking Station (Apex)
products.priceNote: MSRP per Tech Advisor review (Apr 2022) and Anker store
products.provenance: Anker support product page loads the 'Anker 777 Thunderbolt Docking Station (Apex, 12-in-1, Thunderbolt 4)' with 12 ports (1x TB4 upstream 90W, 1x TB4 downstream 15W, 2x HDMI, 4x USB-A, 1x USB-C 20W, GbE, UHS-II SD, audio). 90W host PD, Gigabit Ethernet, and 3 external displays on Windows (2x HDMI + 1x TB4) confirmed by the Tech Advisor review (dated 22 Apr 2022) and Anker spec page. MSRP $349.99 confirmed.

products.name: OWC Thunderbolt 4 Dock
products.priceNote: Original MSRP $249 (CES 2021 launch); OWC store currently lists $229.99
products.provenance: Original draft source URL (owc.com/solutions/thunderbolt-3-dock-14-port) pointed to the WRONG product — a Thunderbolt 3 14-port, 85W dock — and was replaced with OWC's macsales.com page for the actual TB4 11-port dock (OWCTB4DOCK). 11 ports (3x TB4 downstream, 3x USB-A 3.2 Gen 2, 1x USB-A 2.0, GbE, SD 4.0 UHS-II at 312 MB/s, audio), 96W PD, Gigabit Ethernet, dual 4K / single 8K display confirmed on OWC's page. Announced CES 2021. MSRP $249; OWC's own store currently shows $229.99.

products.name: Plugable TBT4-UDZ
products.priceNote: Current price verified live on plugable.com 2026-06-15
products.provenance: 16 ports (2x HDMI, 2x DP, 1x TB4 host, 1x USB-C 10Gb, 6x USB, SD + microSD UHS-II, audio), 100W PD (98W certified), quad 4K display on Windows, and 2.5GbE confirmed directly on Plugable's product page. Current price $269.95 verified live on plugable.com (2026-06-15); the dock launched circa CES 2023 at a higher list price. Note: product page lists release as 2022/2023 era; releaseDate kept as 2023 per launch availability.

products.name: Belkin Connect Pro Thunderbolt 4 Dock (INC006)
products.provenance: 12 ports (1x TB4 host, 1x TB4 downstream, 2x HDMI 2.0, 2x USB-A 3.1, 2x USB-A 2.0, 1x USB-C Gen2, GbE, UHS-II SD, audio) confirmed by Belkin press/support and Zones spec sheet. $299.99 MSRP confirmed from Belkin.com and Zones (Windows Central review notes it is priced higher than the best docks). 90W PD 3.0, Gigabit Ethernet, triple-display in Thunderbolt mode. Announced/released February 24, 2022 per Belkin newsroom.

products.name: Sonnet Echo 20 Thunderbolt 4 SuperDock
products.priceNote: Current US MSRP per sonnettech.com (launch price was $299.99 in June 2023)
products.provenance: Current MSRP $329.99 confirmed directly on sonnettech.com (fetched 2026-06-15); AppleInsider review (June 28, 2023) listed $299.99 at launch. 20 interfaces (3x TB4, internal M.2 NVMe slot, 4x USB-C 10Gb, 4x USB-A 10Gb, HDMI 2.1, 2.5GbE, UHS-II SD 320 MB/s, multiple audio jacks), 100W PD, up to two 6K (or single 8K) displays. Announced June 28, 2023.

products.name: Razer Thunderbolt 4 Dock Chroma
products.priceNote: Launch MSRP $329.99 (corroborated by Engadget/XDA at ~$330); razer.com currently lists from $319.99
products.provenance: 10 ports (4x TB4, 3x USB-A 3.2 Gen 2, GbE, UHS-II SD, 3.5mm audio), 90W PD (135W brick), and dual 4K (single 8K) display confirmed on Razer's product page and XDA review. Ethernet is Gigabit (1GbE) per Razer's official spec — an Amazon listing's keyword-stuffed '2.5 GbE' title is inaccurate and was disregarded. Released early 2021 (Engadget/Tom's Hardware/Windows Central). Launch MSRP $329.99; Razer.com currently shows 'starting from US$319.99'.
